eps.o: In this drawing tutorial parody, when the Animator draws Zed and Addison from Zombies: the Re-animated Series, everyone's favourite power couple encourages the Animator to embrace their singing side with a big musical number.
When the Animator draws Phineas and Ferb, they decide to build a rollercoaster with office supplies on the desk! Will Candace find the model sheet of Mom in time to bust them?!
When the Animator draws her favorite super spy, Perry the Platypus, she puts his spy skills to the test with a dangerous challenge that could shred him.
Barry puts his animator through a BFF Test!
